flags.message: gemini-baseline's reasoning.md presents as a direct quotation from Pet. 27 a concession that petitioner 'did not challenge the fundamental-rights prong of the shocks-the-conscience standard below'. The staged petition.txt contains no such sentence; page 27 states that the issue 'was pressed and passed upon at every stage'. The quoted concession supports one of the four stated downward adjustments and recurs in predicted_reasoning.md. It lowered reasoning_quality for that candidate; correct and brier_score are unaffected.
